spring:
  application:
    name: javaExperience
  datasource:
    # compose.yaml의 mysql(호스트 13308 → 컨테이너 3306)의 community DB(시나리오용). 앱을 띄우기 전에 docker compose up -d
    url: jdbc:mysql://localhost:13308/community?characterEncoding=UTF-8&serverTimezone=Asia/Seoul
    username: community
    password: community
  jpa:
    hibernate:
      # 테이블은 docker/mysql/init/ 의 dump가 만든다. 엔티티가 테이블과 다르면 기동이 실패한다(테이블을 몰래 바꾸지 않음)
      ddl-auto: validate
    # 트랜잭션이 끝나면 커넥션을 바로 반납한다(컨트롤러·직렬화 단계까지 붙잡지 않음)
    open-in-view: false
    properties:
      hibernate:
        format_sql: true

logging:
  level:
    # 실행 SQL은 확인하되 토큰을 포함한 바인딩 값은 로그에 남기지 않는다
    org.hibernate.SQL: debug
    org.hibernate.orm.jdbc.bind: info
mybatis:
  mapper-locations: classpath:mapper/*.xml
  configuration:
    map-underscore-to-camel-case: true

# 0-6 — 내가 정한 설정 값. 코드에서 @Value("${start.greeting}")로 읽는다
start:
  greeting: 반가워요, 백엔드!
  max-items: 5

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.bookmark.MyBatisBookmarkFolderMapper">
    <select id="findSummaries" resultType="org.example.bookmark.BookmarkFolderSummaryResponse">
        SELECT f.id, f.name, COUNT(b.id) AS bookmarkCount
        FROM bookmark_folder f LEFT JOIN bookmark b ON b.folder_id = f.id
        WHERE f.member_id = #{memberId}
        GROUP BY f.id, f.name, f.created_at
        ORDER BY f.created_at ASC, f.id ASC
    </select>
    <select id="lockMember" resultType="long">
        SELECT id FROM member WHERE id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
    </select>
    <select id="countByMember" resultType="long">
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmark_folder WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
    </select>
    <select id="countByName" resultType="int">
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmark_folder
        WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND name = #{name}
        <if test="exceptId != null">AND id != #{exceptId}</if>
    </select>
    <select id="findMine" resultType="org.example.bookmark.BookmarkFolderRow">
        SELECT id, name FROM bookmark_folder WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
    </select>
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="org.example.bookmark.BookmarkFolderInsertRow"
            useGeneratedKeys="true" keyProperty="id">
        INSERT INTO bookmark_folder(member_id, name, created_at, updated_at)
        VALUES (#{memberId}, #{name}, #{at}, #{at})
    </insert>
    <update id="rename">
        UPDATE bookmark_folder SET name = #{name}, updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
    </update>
    <update id="moveAllToDefault">
        UPDATE bookmark SET folder_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE folder_id = #{folderId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
    </update>
    <delete id="deleteMine">
        DELETE FROM bookmark_folder WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
    </delete>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.bookmark.MyBatisBookmarkMapper">
    <select id="findPostStatus" resultType="string">
        SELECT status FROM post WHERE id = #{postId}
    </select>
    <select id="findOwnedFolder" resultType="long">
        SELECT id FROM bookmark_folder WHERE id = #{folderId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
    </select>
    <select id="findBookmark" resultType="org.example.bookmark.BookmarkRow">
        SELECT id, folder_id, memo FROM bookmark
        WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND post_id = #{postId} FOR UPDATE
    </select>
    <insert id="upsert" parameterType="org.example.bookmark.BookmarkInsertRow">
        INSERT INTO bookmark(member_id, post_id, folder_id, memo, created_at, updated_at)
        VALUES (#{memberId}, #{postId}, #{folderId}, #{memo}, #{at}, #{at})
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE folder_id = VALUES(folder_id), memo = VALUES(memo), updated_at = NOW()
    </insert>
    <update id="updateMemo">
        UPDATE bookmark SET memo = #{memo}, updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND post_id = #{postId}
    </update>
    <delete id="deleteByMemberAndPost">
        DELETE FROM bookmark WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND post_id = #{postId}
    </delete>
    <select id="findOwnedBookmark" resultType="org.example.bookmark.BookmarkRow">
        SELECT id, post_id, folder_id, memo FROM bookmark
        WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
    </select>
    <update id="moveBookmark">
        UPDATE bookmark SET folder_id = #{folderId}, updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
    </update>
    <!-- 북마크 자체는 숨기지 않는다. 글 공개 규칙은 응답의 available로 계산한다. -->
    <select id="findMyBookmarks" resultType="org.example.bookmark.BookmarkListRow">
        SELECT b.id, b.post_id, b.folder_id, b.memo, b.created_at AS bookmarked_at,
               p.title, p.author_id, author.nickname AS author_nickname,
               CASE WHEN p.deleted_at IS NULL
                    AND (p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
                         OR (p.status = 'DRAFT' AND p.author_id = #{memberId})
                         OR (p.status = 'HIDDEN' AND #{viewerRole} = 'ADMIN'))
                    AND (p.status != 'PUBLISHED' OR p.visibility != 'FOLLOWERS'
                         OR p.author_id = #{memberId}
                         OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow f WHERE f.follower_id = #{memberId}
                                    AND f.followee_id = p.author_id))
                    AND (p.author_id = #{memberId}
                         OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_block block_rel
                                        WHERE (block_rel.blocker_id = #{memberId} AND block_rel.blocked_id = p.author_id)
                                           OR (block_rel.blocked_id = #{memberId} AND block_rel.blocker_id = p.author_id)))
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS available
        FROM bookmark b
        JOIN post p ON p.id = b.post_id
        JOIN member author ON author.id = p.author_id
        WHERE b.member_id = #{memberId}
        <choose>
            <when test="folderMode == 'DEFAULT'">AND b.folder_id IS NULL</when>
            <when test="folderMode == 'ID'">AND b.folder_id = #{folderId}</when>
        </choose>
        <if test="cursorAt != null">
            AND (b.created_at < #{cursorAt}
                 OR (b.created_at = #{cursorAt} AND b.id < #{cursorId}))
        </if>
        ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC
        LIMIT #{limit}
    </select>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.comment.MyBatisCommentMapper">
    <select id="findParent" resultType="org.example.comment.ParentCommentRow">
        SELECT id, post_id, parent_id, deleted_at FROM comment WHERE id = #{parentId}
    </select>
    <select id="findPostStatus" resultType="string">
        SELECT status FROM post WHERE id = #{postId}
    </select>
    <insert id="insertComment" parameterType="org.example.comment.CommentInsertRow"
            useGeneratedKeys="true" keyProperty="id">
        INSERT INTO comment(post_id, member_id, parent_id, content, created_at, updated_at)
        VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, #{at}, #{at})
    </insert>
    <update id="incrementCommentCount">
        UPDATE post SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId}
    </update>
    <select id="selectTopLevel" resultType="org.example.comment.CommentRow">
        SELECT c.id, c.content, c.created_at,
               m.id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname
        FROM comment c JOIN member m ON m.id = c.member_id
        WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL
          AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC
    </select>
    <select id="selectThreadRows" resultType="org.example.comment.CommentTreeRow">
        SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname,
               c.content, c.created_at, c.deleted_at
        FROM comment c JOIN member m ON m.id = c.member_id
        WHERE c.post_id = #{postId}
        ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC
    </select>
    <select id="selectBlockedMemberIds" resultType="long">
        SELECT CASE WHEN blocker_id = #{viewerId} THEN blocked_id ELSE blocker_id END
        FROM member_block WHERE blocker_id = #{viewerId} OR blocked_id = #{viewerId}
    </select>
    <select id="findForDelete" resultType="org.example.comment.CommentDeleteRow">
        SELECT id, post_id, member_id, deleted_at FROM comment WHERE id = #{id}
    </select>
    <update id="softDelete">
        UPDATE comment SET deleted_at = #{at}, updated_at = #{at}
        WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
    </update>
    <update id="decrementCommentCount">
        UPDATE post SET comment_count = comment_count - 1
        WHERE id = #{postId} AND comment_count > 0
    </update>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.like.MyBatisLikeMapper">
    <select id="findMyLikes" resultType="org.example.like.MyLikeRow">
        SELECT l.id AS like_id, p.id AS post_id, p.title,
               a.id AS author_id, a.nickname AS author_nickname,
               l.created_at AS liked_at
        FROM post_like l
        JOIN post p ON p.id = l.post_id
        JOIN member a ON a.id = p.author_id
        WHERE l.member_id = #{memberId}
          AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
          AND (p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR p.author_id = #{memberId}
               OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow f
                          WHERE f.follower_id = #{memberId} AND f.followee_id = p.author_id))
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_block b
                          WHERE (b.blocker_id = #{memberId} AND b.blocked_id = p.author_id)
                             OR (b.blocked_id = #{memberId} AND b.blocker_id = p.author_id))
          <if test="cursorAt != null">
            AND (l.created_at < #{cursorAt} OR
                 (l.created_at = #{cursorAt} AND l.id < #{cursorId}))
          </if>
        ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC
        LIMIT #{limit}
    </select>
    <select id="findPostStatus" resultType="string">
        SELECT status FROM post WHERE id = #{postId}
    </select>
    <select id="existsLike" resultType="boolean">
        SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_like
                      WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND member_id = #{memberId})
    </select>
    <select id="findLikeCount" resultType="int">
        SELECT like_count FROM post WHERE id = #{postId}
    </select>
    <insert id="insertIgnoreLike">
        INSERT IGNORE INTO post_like(post_id, member_id, created_at)
        VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
    </insert>
    <insert id="insertLike">
        INSERT INTO post_like(post_id, member_id, created_at)
        VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
    </insert>
    <delete id="deleteLike">
        DELETE FROM post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
    </delete>
    <update id="decreaseLikeCount">
        UPDATE post SET like_count = GREATEST(0, like_count - 1) WHERE id = #{postId}
    </update>
    <update id="increaseLikeCount">
        UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId}
    </update>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.marked.MyBatisMarkedPostMapper">
    <!-- 목록과 COUNT가 동일한 공개·차단·표시 조건을 공유한다. -->
    <sql id="markedFromWhere">
        FROM post p
        JOIN member author ON author.id = p.author_id
        JOIN board board_ref ON board_ref.id = p.board_id
        LEFT JOIN post_like l ON l.post_id = p.id AND l.member_id = #{memberId}
        LEFT JOIN bookmark bm ON bm.post_id = p.id AND bm.member_id = #{memberId}
        WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_block blocked
              WHERE (blocked.blocker_id = #{memberId} AND blocked.blocked_id = p.author_id)
                 OR (blocked.blocked_id = #{memberId} AND blocked.blocker_id = p.author_id))
        <choose>
            <when test="liked and bookmarked">AND l.id IS NOT NULL AND bm.id IS NOT NULL</when>
            <when test="liked">AND l.id IS NOT NULL</when>
            <when test="bookmarked">AND bm.id IS NOT NULL</when>
            <otherwise>AND (l.id IS NOT NULL OR bm.id IS NOT NULL)</otherwise>
        </choose>
    </sql>
    <select id="findMarkedPosts" resultType="org.example.marked.MarkedPostRow">
        SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title,
               author.nickname AS author_nickname, board_ref.slug AS board_slug,
               (l.id IS NOT NULL) AS liked, (bm.id IS NOT NULL) AS bookmarked
        <include refid="markedFromWhere" />
        ORDER BY p.id DESC
        LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
    </select>
    <select id="countMarkedPosts" resultType="long">
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        <include refid="markedFromWhere" />
    </select>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.post.MyBatisPopularPostMapper">
    <select id="findPopular" resultType="org.example.post.PopularPostRow">
        SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title,
               COALESCE(l.cnt, 0) * 3 + COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS score,
               COALESCE(l.cnt, 0) AS likes, COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS comments
          FROM post p
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM post_like
                     WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}
                     GROUP BY post_id) l ON l.post_id = p.id
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comment
                     WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}
                     GROUP BY post_id) c ON c.post_id = p.id
         WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND (l.cnt IS NOT NULL OR c.cnt IS NOT NULL)
         ORDER BY score DESC, p.published_at DESC, p.id DESC
         LIMIT #{limit}
    </select>
</mapper>

<mapper namespace="org.example.stats.MyBatisStatsMapper">
    <select id="findMemberActivity" resultType="org.example.stats.MemberActivityRow">
        SELECT m.id AS member_id,
               CASE WHEN m.member_status = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN '탈퇴한 회원' ELSE m.nickname END AS nickname,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post p
                 WHERE p.author_id = m.id AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL) AS posts,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c JOIN post p ON p.id = c.post_id
                 WHERE c.member_id = m.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL) AS comments,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like l JOIN post p ON p.id = l.post_id
                 WHERE p.author_id = m.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL) AS likes_received,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like l WHERE l.member_id = m.id) AS likes_given
          FROM member m
         ORDER BY likes_received DESC, m.id ASC
    </select>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.post.PostReplaceMapper">
    <select id="findTagByName" resultType="org.example.post.PostReplaceTagRow">
        SELECT id, name FROM tag WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
    </select>
    <insert id="insertTagIfMissing">
        INSERT INTO tag(name, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
    </insert>
    <update id="softDelete">
        UPDATE post SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
    </update>
    <update id="patchPost">
        UPDATE post
        <set>
            <if test="title != null">title = #{title},</if>
            <if test="content != null">content = #{content},</if>
            <if test="visibility != null">visibility = #{visibility},</if>
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        </set>
        WHERE id = #{id}
    </update>
    <update id="updatePost">
        UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content},
                        visibility = #{visibility}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = #{id}
    </update>
    <delete id="deletePostTags">
        DELETE FROM post_tag WHERE post_id = #{postId}
    </delete>
    <insert id="insertPostTag">
        INSERT INTO post_tag(post_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{tagId})
    </insert>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.post.PostVisibilityMapper">
    <sql id="listWhere">
        p.board_id = #{boardId}
        AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
        AND (p.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
             <if test="viewerId != null">
                OR p.author_id = #{viewerId}
                OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow f
                           WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.followee_id = p.author_id)
             </if>)
        <if test="viewerId != null">
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_block b
                            WHERE (b.blocker_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocked_id = p.author_id)
                               OR (b.blocked_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocker_id = p.author_id))
        </if>
    </sql>

    <select id="findVisibleDetail" resultType="org.example.post.PostDetailRow">
        SELECT p.id, b.slug AS board_slug, p.title, p.content, p.visibility,
               m.id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname,
               p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.created_at
        FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.id = p.board_id
                    JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id
        WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
               <if test="viewerId != null">OR (p.status = 'DRAFT' AND p.author_id = #{viewerId})</if>
               <if test="viewerRole == 'ADMIN'">OR p.status = 'HIDDEN'</if>)
          AND (p.status != 'PUBLISHED' OR p.visibility != 'FOLLOWERS'
               <if test="viewerId != null">
                   OR p.author_id = #{viewerId}
                   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow f
                              WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.followee_id = p.author_id)
               </if>)
          <if test="viewerId != null">
              AND (p.author_id = #{viewerId} OR NOT EXISTS
                   (SELECT 1 FROM member_block b
                    WHERE (b.blocker_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocked_id = p.author_id)
                       OR (b.blocked_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocker_id = p.author_id)))
          </if>
    </select>

    <update id="increaseViewCount">
        UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
    </update>

    <select id="findMemberId" resultType="long">
        SELECT id FROM member WHERE id = #{memberId}
    </select>
    <select id="selectPublicByAuthorAndBoard" resultType="org.example.post.PostHeadlineRow">
        SELECT p.id, p.title, m.nickname AS author_nickname, b.slug AS board_slug
        FROM post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id
                    JOIN board b ON b.id = p.board_id
        WHERE m.id = #{memberId} AND b.slug = #{boardSlug}
          AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
          AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY p.published_at DESC, p.id DESC
    </select>
    <select id="findBoardIdBySlug" resultType="long">
        SELECT id FROM board WHERE slug = #{slug}
    </select>

    <select id="findViewableByBoard" resultType="org.example.post.PostListRow">
        SELECT p.id, p.title, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.published_at,
               m.id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname
        FROM post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id
        <where><include refid="listWhere"/></where>
        ORDER BY p.published_at DESC, p.id DESC
        LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
    </select>

    <select id="countViewableByBoard" resultType="long">
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post p
        <where><include refid="listWhere"/></where>
    </select>

    <select id="findTagsByPostIds" resultType="org.example.post.PostTagRow">
        SELECT pt.post_id AS postId, t.name FROM post_tag pt
        JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id
        WHERE pt.post_id IN
        <foreach collection="postIds" item="id" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{id}</foreach>
        ORDER BY t.name
    </select>
</mapper>
